title: Release readiness sprint KPI logbook
content:
Purpose: Single-sheet working tracker combining sprint-level roadmap items, launch readiness checklist, and primary KPIs for the upcoming release window. Use as the canonical weekly sync artifact for Product Ops + Eng + SRE.

How to use:
- Update your row at least twice per week.
- Use the Readiness column (Green/Yellow/Red) and keep the short rationale in Notes.
- KPIs are measured against Pre-Launch Target and Post-Launch SLA; track status each week.
- Flags: add Jira key under 'Risk / Blocker' if action required.

Columns (sheet layout):
1) Initiative (short)
2) Owner (name)
3) Product Milestone (what must be true for go/no-go)
4) Sprint (current sprint name/number)
5) Readiness (Green / Yellow / Red)
6) Key KPI - metric
7) Pre-launch target
8) Current value (last measurement)
9) Measurement cadence (prod/canary/manual)
10) Acceptance criteria (pass/fail)
11) Risk / Blocker (Jira id or short desc)
12) Mitigation plan (short)
13) Last updated (YYYY-MM-DD)
14) Notes (1-2 sentence status/ask)

Sample rows (workable examples to copy):

Initiative: Hosted API - 2nd gen throughput
Owner: Marcus Chen
Product Milestone: Stable 99.9% availability on canary, spike-tested to 10k rps for 5m
Sprint: Sprint 18 - Oct
Readiness: Yellow
Key KPI - metric: p95 latency (text gen, 512 tokens)
Pre-launch target: <= 220 ms
Current value (last measurement): 260 ms (canary 2025-02-14)
Measurement cadence: Canary hourly, dashboard
Acceptance criteria: p95 <=220ms for 72h under average traffic + no regressions in 10 eval prompts
Risk / Blocker: JIRA-OPS-1832 (kernel fallback perf regression)
Mitigation plan: Enable soft-kernel routing + roll back to prev kernel if p95 >240ms
Last updated: 2025-02-17
Notes: Perf team investigating. Canary traffic limited to 30% of test fleet. Request SRE to extend canary window one more day.

Initiative: Dedicated - reserved capacity autoscale
Owner: Lea Novak
Product Milestone: Autoscaler passes chaos tests, billing usage estimates validated with finance
Sprint: Sprint 18 - Oct
Readiness: Green
Key KPI - metric: Scale-up latency (time from surge to target throughput)
Pre-launch target: < 45s to reach committed throughput
Current value (last measurement): 38s (load test 2025-02-12)
Measurement cadence: Load test & smoke daily
Acceptance criteria: <45s in 5/5 load windows + no data plane errors
Risk / Blocker: none
Mitigation plan: N/A
Last updated: 2025-02-16
Notes: Finance validated committed tier pricing impact; PS brief updated.

Initiative: Private deployment - VPC onboarding pilot
Owner: Devon Ortiz
Product Milestone: Successful pilot with customer A (on-prem), audit logs captured to KMS, zero-secrets exposure
Sprint: Sprint 18 - Oct
Readiness: Yellow
Key KPI - metric: Time-to-onboard (days from signed SOW to deployed env)
Pre-launch target: <= 10 days
Current value (last measurement): 14 days (pilot 2025-01)
Measurement cadence: Per-customer postmortem
Acceptance criteria: <=10 days across two pilot customers OR documented major blocker and mitigation
Risk / Blocker: JIRA-SEC-2040 (KMS integration edge cases)
Mitigation plan: Work with security to approve interim HSM flow; add runbook; schedule additional deployment window
Last updated: 2025-02-15
Notes: Customer B demo scheduled 2025-02-25, need more runbook items.

Initiative: Console rollout - per-route observability
Owner: Riley Gomez
Product Milestone: Dashboards show token-level cost/latency for top 10 routes; tracing hooks in place
Sprint: Sprint 18 - Oct
Readiness: Red
Key KPI - metric: Percent of routes with token-level telemetry
Pre-launch target: 90% of top routes
Current value (last measurement): 47%
Measurement cadence: nightly job
Acceptance criteria: 90% + UI smoke tests pass
Risk / Blocker: JIRA-UX-569 (UI perf), JIRA-OBS-1901 (trace sampling mismatch)
Mitigation plan: Scope MVP to top 50 routes and schedule phased UI perf fixes; QA to validate sampling config
Last updated: 2025-02-16
Notes: Need design decision on top routes filter. PM to prioritize.

Initiative: Optimize - intelligent batching suggestion engine
Owner: Aisha Patel
Product Milestone: Suggestor achieves >=10% estimated cost savings on synthetic workload with <5% latency regression
Sprint: Sprint 18 - Oct
Readiness: Yellow
Key KPI - metric: Estimated cost delta (1k token equivalent)
Pre-launch target: >=10% savings (simulated workloads)
Current value (last measurement): 8% savings, 3.2% latency regression (canary)
Measurement cadence: daily experiment runs + weekly evals
Acceptance criteria: >=10% cost savings and latency regression <=5% across 3 test suites
Risk / Blocker: JIRA-OPT-321 (edge case prompts causing batching harm)
Mitigation plan: Add rule-based fallback for short prompts; whitelist high-penalty routes
Last updated: 2025-02-17
Notes: Need product sign-off on fallback heuristics.

Weekly KPI summary (top-level metrics to watch across initiatives):
- Global availability (prod): target 99.95% pre-launch, current 99.92% -> weekly trend: small improvement after infra fixes.
- Error rate (5xx): target <0.5%, current 0.6% (canary spike on 2025-02-14)
- p95 latency (hosted text gen, 512 tokens): target <=220ms, current 260ms
- Cost per 1k tokens (baseline): target <= $0.95, current estimated $0.98
- Time to onboard private customer: target <=10d, current average 14d

Readiness heatmap guidance (how to pick Green/Yellow/Red):
- Green: Acceptance criteria met OR only low-severity risks with clear mitigation and no blockers in Jira.
- Yellow: At least one open medium-severity blocker OR KPI within 10-20% of target requiring attention.
- Red: High-severity unresolved blocker, KPI outside acceptable range (>20% off) or security/compliance gaps.

Weekly ritual checklist (Product Ops owner):
- Monday: Collect last_updated rows from owners; triage new blockers and escalate to SRE/Eng leads.
- Wednesday: Mid-week sync, update KPIs and confirm mitigation progress.
- Friday: Publish short status snapshot to #product-ops and attach export to Confluence page.

Export / reporting:
- Export CSV weekly and paste into Confluence release page under 'Readiness snapshots'.
- Attach last 3 weeks of KPI charts for trend context.

Notes on permanence: This is a working sheet. For final post-mortem, copy the final row set into the formal Release Playbook in Confluence and tag the relevant Jira epic.

Open questions for the next review:
- Do we want to include cost-sensitivity weighting per initiative (high/med/low) so that Optimize savings are prioritized differently?
- Should Privacy & Compliance perform a mandatory pre-launch checklist for Private deployments and mark 'security-blocker' boolean column?

-- End of sheet --

Authors: Aisha Patel (product-ops) initial template, updates consolidated by Marcus Chen and Riley Gomez.
